mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the GDP growth condition is met, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within three months signals an improving labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production index by more than 2% over three months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the real personal consumption expenditures by more than 1% over two consecutive months signals a weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenues and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between RSAFS decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payroll employment by more than 200,000 over a month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts increase by more than 5% and consumer price index increases by more than 0.5% over the same month, it signals a strong demand coupled with inflationary pressure, which boosts certain sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint correlation between the proxies and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1% and the consumer price index increases by more than 2% over six months, it signals accommodative monetary policy coupled with rising inflation, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors seek higher returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 2% in 6 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint correlation between the proxies and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
